data.name: Solomon
data.title: King of Israel
data.description: The son of David and Bathsheba, renowned for his wisdom and for building the first Temple in Jerusalem.
data.scripture_text: David was the father of Solomon (whose mother was Bathsheba, the widow of Uriah).

data.name: Rehoboam
data.title: King of Judah
data.description: The son of Solomon whose rejection of the people's request for lighter taxes led to the division of the kingdom.
data.scripture_text: Solomon was the father of Rehoboam. Rehoboam was the father of Abijah. Abijah was the father of Asa.

data.name: Abijah
data.title: King of Judah
data.description: The son of Rehoboam who reigned over Judah and continued the war against the northern kingdom of Israel.
data.scripture_text: Solomon was the father of Rehoboam. Rehoboam was the father of Abijah. Abijah was the father of Asa.

data.name: Asa
data.title: King of Judah
data.description: A king of Judah who was noted for his early religious reforms and his heart being fully committed to the Lord.
data.scripture_text: Asa was the father of Jehoshaphat. Jehoshaphat was the father of Jehoram. Jehoram was the father of Uzziah.

data.name: Jehoshaphat
data.title: King of Judah
data.description: The son of Asa who strengthened Judah and walked in the ways of his father by seeking the Lord.
data.scripture_text: Asa was the father of Jehoshaphat. Jehoshaphat was the father of Jehoram. Jehoram was the father of Uzziah.

data.name: Jehoram
data.title: King of Judah
data.description: The son of Jehoshaphat who married Athaliah, the daughter of Ahab, and led Judah into idolatry.
data.scripture_text: Asa was the father of Jehoshaphat. Jehoshaphat was the father of Jehoram. Jehoram was the father of Uzziah.

data.name: Uzziah
data.title: King of Judah
data.description: Also known as Azariah, he was a powerful king who reigned for fifty-two years but was later struck with leprosy.
data.scripture_text: Uzziah was the father of Jotham. Jotham was the father of Ahaz. Ahaz was the father of Hezekiah.

data.name: Jotham
data.title: King of Judah
data.description: The son of Uzziah who grew powerful because he walked steadfastly before the Lord his God.
data.scripture_text: Uzziah was the father of Jotham. Jotham was the father of Ahaz. Ahaz was the father of Hezekiah.

data.name: Ahaz
data.title: King of Judah
data.description: A wicked king of Judah who refused to trust in God and instead sought help from the king of Assyria.
data.scripture_text: Uzziah was the father of Jotham. Jotham was the father of Ahaz. Ahaz was the father of Hezekiah.

data.name: Hezekiah
data.title: King of Judah
data.description: One of the most prominent kings of Judah, known for his religious reforms and his reliance on God during the Assyrian siege.
data.scripture_text: Hezekiah was the father of Manasseh. Manasseh was the father of Amon. Amon was the father of Josiah.

data.name: Manasseh
data.title: King of Judah
data.description: The son of Hezekiah who reigned longer than any other king of Judah; he was initially wicked but repented in captivity.
data.scripture_text: Hezekiah was the father of Manasseh. Manasseh was the father of Amon. Amon was the father of Josiah.

data.name: Amon
data.title: King of Judah
data.description: The son of Manasseh who abandoned the Lord and was assassinated by his own officials after a short reign.
data.scripture_text: Hezekiah was the father of Manasseh. Manasseh was the father of Amon. Amon was the father of Josiah.

data.name: Josiah
data.title: King of Judah
data.description: The boy-king who initiated a major reformation after the Book of the Law was found in the Temple.
data.scripture_text: Josiah was the father of Jehoiachin and his brothers (born at the time of the exile to Babylon).

data.name: Jehoiachin
data.title: King of Judah
data.description: The son of Jehoiakim (called Jehoiachin in Matthew) who was taken captive to Babylon; he is the last king in the royal line before the exile.
data.scripture_text: Josiah was the father of Jehoiachin and his brothers (born at the time of the exile to Babylon).

data.name: Shealtiel
data.title: Son of Jehoiachin
data.description: The son of Jehoiachin, born during the Babylonian exile, through whom the Davidic line continued.
data.scripture_text: After the Babylonian exile: Jehoiachin was the father of Shealtiel. Shealtiel was the father of Zerubbabel.

data.name: Zerubbabel
data.title: Governor of Judah
data.description: The leader of the first return of exiles from Babylon who laid the foundation of the second Temple.
data.scripture_text: Zerubbabel was the father of Abiud. Abiud was the father of Eliakim. Eliakim was the father of Azor.

data.name: Abiud
data.title: Son of Zerubbabel
data.description: An ancestor of Jesus in the royal line of David following the return from Babylonian exile.
data.scripture_text: Zerubbabel was the father of Abiud. Abiud was the father of Eliakim. Eliakim was the father of Azor.

data.name: Eliakim
data.title: Son of Abiud
data.description: An ancestor in the royal genealogy of Jesus Christ, as recorded by the Apostle Matthew.
data.scripture_text: Zerubbabel was the father of Abiud. Abiud was the father of Eliakim. Eliakim was the father of Azor.

data.name: Azor
data.title: Son of Eliakim
data.description: A descendant of David in the royal line leading to the Messiah.
data.scripture_text: Azor was the father of Zadok. Zadok was the father of Akim. Akim was the father of Eliud.

data.name: Zadok
data.title: Son of Azor
data.description: An ancestor of Jesus Christ, not to be confused with the high priests of the same name.
data.scripture_text: Azor was the father of Zadok. Zadok was the father of Akim. Akim was the father of Eliud.

data.name: Akim
data.title: Son of Zadok
data.description: An ancestor of Jesus in the lineage of the kings of Judah.
data.scripture_text: Azor was the father of Zadok. Zadok was the father of Akim. Akim was the father of Eliud.

data.name: Eliud
data.title: Son of Akim
data.description: A descendant of David whose name appears in the genealogy of Jesus in Matthew's Gospel.
data.scripture_text: Eliud was the father of Eleazar. Eleazar was the father of Matthan. Matthan was the father of Jacob.

data.name: Eleazar
data.title: Son of Eliud
data.description: An ancestor of Joseph, the husband of Mary, in the Davidic royal line.
data.scripture_text: Eliud was the father of Eleazar. Eleazar was the father of Matthan. Matthan was the father of Jacob.

data.name: Matthan
data.title: Son of Eleazar
data.description: The grandfather of Joseph, the husband of Mary, in the royal genealogy of Jesus.
data.scripture_text: Eliud was the father of Eleazar. Eleazar was the father of Matthan. Matthan was the father of Jacob.

data.name: Jacob
data.title: Father of Joseph
data.description: The son of Matthan and father of Joseph the husband of Mary, representing the final generation before the birth of Christ in Matthew's record.
data.scripture_text: Jacob was the father of Joseph, the husband of Mary. Mary gave birth to Jesus, who is called the Messiah.

data.name: Joseph
data.title: Husband of Mary
data.description: A descendant of King David and a righteous man who served as the legal father of Jesus on earth.
data.scripture_text: Jacob was the father of Joseph, the husband of Mary. Mary gave birth to Jesus, who is called the Messiah.

data.name: Jesus
data.title: The Messiah
data.description: The Son of God and Savior of the world, born of the Virgin Mary, the ultimate fulfillment of the Davidic royal line.
data.scripture_text: Jacob was the father of Joseph, the husband of Mary. Mary gave birth to Jesus, who is called the Messiah.
